claim: For nutrient maps used to support management classes, continuous prediction metrics should be complemented by class accuracy or misclassification severity.
conditions: Applies when soil indicators are interpreted using agronomic classes, such as low/medium/high nutrient status.
limitations: Class thresholds vary by crop, region, extraction method and local agronomic guideline.
recommended_action: Report class accuracy when class bins exist, and warn against detailed fertilizer decisions when class accuracy is low.
not_allowed_action: Do not use a low-accuracy class map for precise fertilizer prescription without expert review.
